brand.name: SchemeSaathi
brand.tagline: Government Scheme Discovery & Application Readiness Platform

home.hero_title: Find Government Schemes. Understand Your Eligibility. Get Application-Ready.
home.hero_subtitle: Discover government benefits, understand eligibility in your language, and prepare the documents you need — all in one place.
home.search_placeholder: Search schemes (e.g. PM-KISAN, scholarship, health cover, farmer grant)...
home.process_banner: Discover → Check Eligibility → Prepare Documents → Take the Next Step
home.how_it_works_subtitle: A transparent 4-step path designed for citizens, rural families, and CSC operators.
home.step1_desc: Browse verified Central and State welfare programs categorized by sector, beneficiary group, and financial benefits.
home.step2_desc: Answer clear, simple questions. Our deterministic rule engine explains exactly why you qualify or what information is missing.
home.step3_desc: Review the required government documents, issuing authorities, acceptable alternatives, and track your personal checklist locally.
home.step4_desc: Access direct links to official government portals and know what to submit without middleman fees or guesswork.
home.rule_engine_desc: Decisions are computed using audited rule trees based on official ministry gazettes. No AI guesswork for qualification decisions.
home.privacy_desc: We do not collect Aadhaar numbers, PAN, or phone numbers. Eligibility checks run anonymously without identity profiling.
home.citations_desc: Every benefit, eligibility rule, and procedure links directly to the responsible ministry portal or official gazette notification.
home.eligibility_explainer_desc: We evaluate conditions systematically against official guidelines to provide auditable, clear outcomes.
home.faq_q1: Is SchemeSaathi an official government website?
home.faq_a1: SchemeSaathi is an independent citizen-readiness platform providing information grounded in official government gazette notifications. We direct you to the official ministry portals for actual submission.
home.faq_q2: Do I need to submit my Aadhaar card or pay any fee?
home.faq_a2: No. SchemeSaathi is completely free. We never ask for Aadhaar numbers, PAN, bank passwords, or payment.
home.faq_q3: Can SchemeSaathi guarantee my scheme approval?
home.faq_a3: No. SchemeSaathi helps you check your eligibility and prepare your documents. Final scheme approval rests solely with the competent government authority or department.
home.faq_q4: Does the document checklist upload my private files?
home.faq_a4: No. Your document readiness checklist is stored locally in your web browser. No files or private data are ever uploaded to any server.
home.final_cta_desc: Start your eligibility check now in English, Hindi, or Kannada.
home.footer_legal: SchemeSaathi is an informational welfare readiness tool. Official submissions must be made through authorized government portals or local Common Service Centres (CSCs).
